PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-002.text: RLP-encoded nodes under 32 bytes return unencoded form; nodes >= 32 bytes return keccak256 hash.
PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-002.assertion: forall node: (len(rlp.encode(node)) < 32 => return unencoded) && (len(rlp.encode(node)) >= 32 => return keccak256(encoded))

locations.note: RLP encoding logic with 32-byte threshold for hashing
